title: Inherited Adapter Experts for Replay-Free Domain-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Replay-free domain-incremental learning trains a model on the same classes in successive domains without keeping earlier images. Per-domain learners freeze a pre-trained ViT and train an additional expert for each new domain: the small set of parameters and the classification head learned on that domain. Test images carry no domain label, so a router selects one expert for each image. Recent work trains this router. However, a training-free Mahalanobis router costs the analyzed learners under 2.7 points of final accuracy relative to always selecting each image's own-domain expert. The experts, not this router, limit accuracy. Our learner, Lamarck, therefore uses this router and strengthens the experts. Its adapters, small trainable layers that correct every image token after each deep ViT block, add 4.4 points of final accuracy on the deepfake benchmark CDDB-Hard. In addition, each expert is initialized from its predecessor at no extra

translated_title: 面向无回放域增量学习的继承式适配器专家
translated_abstract: 无回放域增量学习是在连续出现的域上对相同类别进行模型训练，且不保留早期的图像。基于每个域的学习器会冻结预训练的ViT，并为每个新域训练一个额外的专家：即在该域上学到的少量参数以及分类头。由于测试图像不携带域标签，需要由一个路由器为每张图像选择对应的专家。近期的工作致力于训练这个路由器。然而，一个无需训练的马氏距离路由器，相对于始终为每张图像选择其自身所属域专家的理想情况，最终准确率的损失不超过2.7个百分点。因此，限制准确率的并非路由器，而是专家本身。基于此，我们提出的学习器Lamarck采用了这种路由器，并将改进的重点放在强化专家上。其适配器（即在ViT每个深层模块之后对每个图像token进行修正的小型可训练层）在深度伪造基准CDDB-Hard上带来了4.4个百分点的最终准确率提升。此外，每个专家都从其前驱专家继承初始化，且不产生额外开销……
tldr: 该论文发现限制无回放域增量学习性能的是各域专家而非路由器，并提出Lamarck方法，通过在ViT每个深层块后引入可训练适配器来强化专家、并让每个专家从前驱专家继承初始化，从而显著提升准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Lamarck, showing that experts—not the router—limit accuracy in replay-free domain-incremental learning, and strengthens per-domain experts with trainable adapters after each deep ViT block plus inherited initialization from predecessor experts.
